name: hiready-monorepo
description: Hiready - AI Powered Interview Bot (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix hiready-backend" "npm run dev --prefix hiready-frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix hiready-frontend && npm run lint --prefix hiready-backend && npm run lint:tests
scripts.test: npm test --prefix hiready-backend && npm run typecheck --prefix hiready-frontend && npm run test --prefix hiready-frontend
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix hiready-backend && npm ci --prefix hiready-frontend
